user.title: Connect your Maytag appliance account
user.description: Enter the account used by the Maytag app. Washers and dryers will be discovered automatically.

reconfigure.title: Update Maytag appliance settings
reconfigure.description: Update the account. Leave the password blank to keep the currently saved password. Washers and dryers are discovered automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your Maytag appliance account
reauth_confirm.description: The Maytag appliance service rejected the saved credentials. Enter the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Maytag appliance service.
error.invalid_auth: The email or password is incorrect.
error.no_appliances: No supported Maytag washer or dryer was found on this account.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The account email cannot be changed. Remove and add the integration again to use another account.
